g.title: attempts > MAX_ATTEMPTS returns 429 Too Many Requests
login() Sends the credentials to the API; the server answers with a session cookie.
loginRateLimit() Allows at most five login attempts per IP and minute.
validateBody() Validates the request body against a zod schema.
authController.login() Authenticates email + password and starts a cookie-based session.
throw Error login() throws Error: "Invalid email or password".
redis.incr Writes to redis via redis (incr).
attempts > MAX_ATTEMPTS loginRateLimit() branches on `attempts > MAX_ATTEMPTS`.
findUserByEmail() Looks up a user by their (case-insensitive) email address.
redis.expire Writes to redis via redis (expire).
429 Too Many Requests loginRateLimit() responds with HTTP 429.
400 Bad Request validateBody() responds with HTTP 400.
user.findUnique Reads from user via prisma (findUnique).
recordFailedLogin() Stores a failed login attempt so rate limiting and audits can see it.
verifyPassword() Compares a plain-text password with the stored bcrypt hash.
loginAttempt.create Writes to loginAttempt via prisma (create).
createSession() Creates a session record that expires after two weeks.
setSessionCookie() Writes the session id to an HTTP-only cookie.
toPublicUser() export function toPublicUser(user: { id: string; email: string }): PublicUser
session.create Writes to session via prisma (create).
on user.loggedIn handler async ({ userId }: { userId: string }) =>
user.update Writes to user via prisma (update).
